text:
devon: heads-up — release cutoff is in ~48h (Fri 10:00 PT). we need sign-offs on changelog + security review + QA smoke before then. please drop quick statuses.

maria: working on changelog, PR #4827. still finishing one line for dedupe cache note. should be done by EOD today.

aj: version bump PR opened: `bump v1.12.0 -> v1.12.1` (PR #4830). only fixes and docs. tagging releases/1.12.1 branch.

harper: QA schedule: smoke tests tomorrow 09:00 PT, full regression Thu 16:00 PT. need feature flags for canary on staging.

chris: security doing a quick review this afternoon. will check dependency update list and SCA output. if anything blocks we'll call it out by 17:00.

qa-lead: can someone confirm migrations? I saw `schema_v42` migration in changelog. is that behind a feature flag?

maria: good catch — migrations are gated behind `--enable-schema-v42` flags on deploy. we won't flip by default. adding a note to the changelog and release notes.

devon: branch plan: merge all release PRs into `release/1.12.x` branch. freeze `main` for minor merges. after cutoff, only hotfixes to `release/1.12.x` with approvals.

aj: created the branch and pushed. `git fetch && git checkout release/1.12.x` convos in PR.

harper: test infra note — running a quick perf run after merge, could take ~45m. I'll report pass/fail in this thread.

security-bot: SCA scan completed for PR #4827, #4830 — 0 high, 2 medium (dev deps). See report: https://snyk.internal/scan/4830

chris: digging into the mediums now. both are devdeps that don't ship. low risk but will add a mitigation note.

devon: changelog nudges: @maria @aj please ensure each PR has a one-liner under the correct section (Fixed / Changed / Security). we prefer concise start-case sentences.

maria: updated #4827 — added entry under Fixed: "Prevent duplicate cache keys for reranker".

aj: added `Version bump: v1.12.1` under Changed + link to PR.

qa-lead: quick checklist for my QA run:

```
- smoke on staging
- validate key endpoints: /generate, /chat, /embeddings
- run tokenization smoke
- verify canary fallback to smaller model
```
I'll paste results here.

harper: smoke run started (09:03 PT). will post logs.

harper: smoke run PASS for /generate and /chat, slight latency bump on long-context tests (~15ms). filing ticket if it persists post-merge.

devon: security sign-off required: @chris ok to mark security reviewed if only devdeps. otherwise need remediation plan.

chris: marking security reviewed — 2 medium devdeps, mitigation: pin to checked-in lockfile + ticket to upgrade in next minor. adding comment on PRs.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for Fri 10:30 PT to `canary-us-west`. Will run 1k rps for 10 minutes then promote if no errors >0.5%.

devon: final doc check — @maria can you confirm the release notes doc in /docs/releases/1.12.1.md is complete? we need the ```
